title: Micro Economics
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a finished good, which is used to produce another good."
Capital is a finished good, which is used to produce another good.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a graphical relationship between the quantities supply at various prices."
A supply curve is a graphical relationship between the quantities supply at various prices.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the combination of factor inputs the firm can purchase with a given monetary cost outlay."
An isocost line can be defined as the combination of factor inputs the firm can purchase with a given monetary cost outlay.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the only commodities consumed by the individual."
Assuming these commodities are the only commodities consumed by the individual.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount spent for each of the variable input used."
The total variable cost is the amount spent for each of the variable input used.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the increase in revenue obtained by selling an additional unit of output."
Marginal revenue is the increase in revenue obtained by selling an additional unit of output.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the ratio of the percentage change in the quantity supplied to the percentage change in its price."
Price elasticity of supply can be defined as the ratio of the percentage change in the quantity supplied to the percentage change in its price.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those where goods and services are bought and sold."
Goods markets are those where goods and services are bought and sold.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a useful tool for analysing consumer behavior and allocating consumer budget between goods and services in a given time frame."
Utility theory is a useful tool for analysing consumer behavior and allocating consumer budget between goods and services in a given time frame.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a concept introduced by Marshall to mean the extra utility or satisfaction consumer's gain by paying less for an item than they would be willing and able to pay for it rather than forego it."

The consumer surplus is a concept introduced by Marshall to mean the extra utility or satisfaction consumer's gain by paying less for an item than they would be willing and able to pay for it rather than forego it.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the difference between total revenue and total cost."
Total profit is the difference between total revenue and total cost.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the horizontal summation of individual demand for a commodity at a given price and time."
The market demand is defined as the horizontal summation of individual demand for a commodity at a given price and time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the formulation and testing of models."
The basic procedure is the formulation and testing of models.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the physical and intellectual exertion of human beings."
Labor is defined as the physical and intellectual exertion of human beings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most basic material for all production."
Land is the most basic material for all production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a model to make predictions about the route a driver will take to get a particular destination."
A road map is a model to make predictions about the route a driver will take to get a particular destination.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the desire to obtain goods or services and the willingness and ability to pay for them."
Demand in economic refer to the desire to obtain goods or services and the willingness and ability to pay for them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an approach to consumer behavioral theory which emphasis on preference or indifference."
Indifference curve analysis is an approach to consumer behavioral theory which emphasis on preference or indifference.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as that price at which the quantity offered for sale equal to the quantity consumers are willing and able to buy."
Market equilibrium can be defined as that price at which the quantity offered for sale equal to the quantity consumers are willing and able to buy.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that as you attain more utility of one good, fewer units of another good is required to compensate for the loss of one unit of the good that is become scarce."
The convexity feature means that as you attain more utility of one good, fewer units of another good is required to compensate for the loss of one unit of the good that is become scarce.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the principal users of the services of factors of production."
Firms are the principal users of the services of factors of production.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the monetary help given by the government to reduce the high cost of production so that it may be possible for the producer to sell his commodity at a lower price and still make profit."
Subsidy is the monetary help given by the government to reduce the high cost of production so that it may be possible for the producer to sell his commodity at a lower price and still make profit.
